jobs.description: AI Agents for Marketing Teams | Arito Book A Demo Platform Use Cases Finance Revenue Marketing Blog Resources Resource Center Podcasts E-books Download E-Book Company About Us Contact Us Careers News Pricing Log in Try it now Book A Demo REAL-TIME PIPELINE VISIBILITY & OPTIMIZATION Optimize your channels performance Allocate resources intelligently across channels Calculate conversion rates of your lead generation vehicles Understand exactly what your customers are asking for Differentiate yourself against competitors and and tell the story that wins It shouldn’t be that hard to measure and optimize your channels. But it is. You don’t know how lead generation is actually performing Leads live across your CRM, email, and events. Each shows part of the story, but none give you a complete, consistent view of channel performance over time. You don’t have access to the numbers Simple questions like “How much pipeline did our last event create?” or “What’s the win rate by source?” turn into tickets, delays, and guesswork. Budget decisions feel like guesswork Without real-time metrics or scenario analysis, it’s impossible to know where each dollar should go to reliably hit your targets. Customer signals are scattered everywhere Feature requests and competitor mentions are buried in emails, Slack, and calls—forcing teams to piece together insights manually, usually too late. Finally see exactly what’s going on with your marketing efforts. Skip BI queues and stale spreadsheets. Arito brings your CRM, revenue, and ops data into one live view—so you can understand marketing performance instantly, allocate resources with clarity, and hit your targets with confidence. Zoom In And Zoom Out Model how different channel allocations change results. Compare scenarios side by side with projected pipeline, revenue, and ROI. Messaging That Wins Deals Understand which messages move deals forward – by persona, industry, and funnel stage. Identify the talk tracks that correlate with progression, the objections that stall pipeline, and the competitor mentions that change outcomes. Refine your story and enable campaigns and teams with proven language tied to revenue. Leading Indicator Analytics Arito allows you to continuously calculate any KPI you could dream of: conversion rates, churn, NDR, and more – flagging unusual trends for you the moment they emerge so you can take preventive action. Stay Ahead Of Every Shift Set up role-specific alerts for different team members to keep everyone on track, all the time – from pipeline generation to target coverage and achieving quotas. End-to-End Channel Visibility See which channels create pipeline, which deals stall, and why. Roll up results by fiscal quarter, compare conversion and sales-cycle velocity by channel, forecast pipeline, and identify where to shift spend and what messaging to change to improve win rates, across all your channels. Get Answers Instantly Get answers to questions like “How much pipe our website has created in the past quarter?” or “what’s the conversion rate of our events?” and get instant answers. No BI queue or SQL needed. What happens when marketing teams use arito’s self-service data platform 01 Connect your systems Arito automatically plugs into your ERP, CRM, expense tools, and more. No manual export, model building, or complex integrations. 02 Arito makes sense of your data Our platform analyzes your financial and operational data – understanding nuanced relationships and context just like you do and it creates a powerful semantic layer on top. 03 Start getting answers Get instant answers to your budget questions, run multiple scenarios in real-time, and set up automated monitoring. Now that’s easy. 04 Monitor and Act Turn every question into a live self-updating dashboard in seconds. Set alerts to monitor in realtime and get notifications in any channel you’d like. Deploy it your way. Use it your way. Your data stays yours. arito does not share your data with LLM providers or any third-party applications. How does arito help prove marketing’s impact on revenue? arito can build the entire journey of an account, from inception to closing to renewals, including all the relevant customer data and interaction insights so you have a full and end-to-end view of how your marketing is affecting the top line. Does arito surface competitive insights? Yes—arito identifies when competitors or alternatives are discussed and why. Can arito learn from customer conversations and interactions? jobs.title: About Us
jobs.description: About Us | Arito's Mission for Decision Intelligence Book A Demo Platform Use Cases Finance Revenue Marketing Blog Resources Resource Center Podcasts E-books Download E-Book Company About Us Contact Us Careers News Pricing Log in Try it now Book A Demo About us What enterprises dream of. We are building it. Modern businesses run on dozens of applications. Finance, GTM, and operations teams each manage multiple data sources – yet decision-makers still hunt for insights in manually built spreadsheets, Slack threads, and outdated dashboards. Teams spend more time reconciling numbers and wrangling data to produce answers than acting on them. Too often, decisions end up relying on stale numbers and analyses compromised by human error. Our goal: help teams make better decisions, faster. arito is a context-aware AI platform that connects your data sources, applies shared context, and delivers trusted answers across Finance, GTM, and Operations teams. Instead of isolated tools or generic chatbots, arito becomes a common intelligence layer that democratizes the ability to process business data across the entire enterprise. Insights only matter when they lead to action Data without context is noise Trust comes from accuracy, consistency, and transparency The best technology amplifies people – it doesn’t replace them A note from our founders We started arito after identifying the same pattern in all companies, from small startups to conglomerate enterprises. Hours lost to spreadsheets. Endless back-and-forth over “whose numbers are right.” Important decisions slowed down because the data existed — but the insights didn’t. The problem wasn’t a lack of tools. It was the lack of a shared intelligence layer — one that understands context, roles, and how teams actually work together. That’s why we built arito: a platform designed to bring clarity across systems and alignment across teams. No black boxes. No brittle dashboards. Just clear, explainable insights you can act on. This is only the beginning, and we’re excited to build the future of decision intelligence with you. jobs.description: We are seeking an accomplished AI Research Scientist who is passionate about building transformative AI-driven solutions and contributing to a culture where the best ideas win. As an integral part of the founding team, you will lead the company’s research initiatives, align foundational scientific efforts with product strategy, and set the standard for excellence in R&D. If you are a proactive leader ready to take ownership and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, we want to meet you.Key Responsibilities:Lead the research of cutting-edge, deployment-driven AI technologies that push the boundaries of current AI applications in the financial realm.Lead and develop the scientific core of the company, ensuring that foundational research aligns with long-term strategic and product goals.Work closely with the CTO and other stakeholders to define the technological vision to drive the product roadmap.Leadership role in onboarding future researchers and setting the quality standards for R&D and technical discussionCultivate a culture of excellence, innovation, and ownership.Qualification:Advanced degree (MSc/PhD) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics or a related field from a top-tier institution.At least 5+ years of experience in AI/algorithm research roles with substantial experience taking research ideas from concept all the way to production.Strong understanding of state-of-the-art algorithms and models in AI and deep learning, with a passion for staying at the forefront of research advancements.Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate your own work and assess its real-world performance and impact.Comfortable with the pace and ambiguity of a fast-growing startup environment.Being a self-starter, who can proactively identify opportunities for impact even when they’re not assigned to you.
